$comment: The 8.0 rule registry (RFC 0008 §3.2). Ids are never reused: a rule whose meaning changes gets a new id and the old one is marked superseded. pending names the PR that implements the rule; the switch (RFC 0008 S1) needs every pending to be null. properties and guards name tests as module-directory:TestClass#test name; verifyRuleCoverage checks that they exist. A build or startup rule is covered by those tests instead of scenarios.

rules.statement: A declared non-empty space the principal has no role in is Rejected(SPACE_NOT_MEMBER); it never falls back to the default space (C3).
properties: model:ScopeResolverPropertyTest#P11 a resolved scope only narrows

rules.statement: When the host is configured with an app, a different declared app is Rejected(APP_MISMATCH), and without a declaration the host's app applies (C4); without a host app the declared app applies.
properties: model:ScopeResolverPropertyTest#the app and tenant follow the host and the credential

rules.statement: An anonymous request that declares CoSec-Space-Id is answered 401.
When the header and the query parameter of the same CoSec-* parameter differ, the request cannot be read unambiguously and is answered 400.
guards: cosec-spring-boot-starter:WebAdapterParityTest#the three adapters answer byte for byte alike

rules.statement: Only ScopeResolver constructs a Scope; no decoding path (JSON, header, cache) deserializes one.
An unauthenticated subject is always in the default tenant (0) and has no roles, whatever memberships it is given.
guards: model:ScopeResolverTest#an anonymous subject is in the default tenant and has no roles

rules.statement: A declared app that cannot be an app id (blank, *, containing ':' or longer than 128 characters) is Rejected(APP_MISMATCH), with or without a host app.
guards: model:ScopeResolverTest#a declared app that cannot be an app id is rejected with or without a host app

rules.statement: The app is checked before the space: a request failing both is Rejected(APP_MISMATCH).
guards: model:ScopeResolverTest#the app is checked before the space

rules.statement: A token that carries the membership marker together with role or policy claims fails closed: Indeterminate(MembershipUnavailable).
When the MembershipProvider is missing, fails or times out, the decision is Indeterminate(MembershipUnavailable); it never falls back to the token's claims or to no memberships.

Membership claims read as 7.x RoleScope: `role` is a role in the default space, `role@space` a role in that space only, and a malformed entry (empty role or space, more than one @, `role@*`) applies in no space.
After revokeSubject(tenant, principal, issuedBefore), every token of that principal issued before the instant is rejected.
An expired binding does not apply.
guards: engine:FlatEngineTest#principal bindings apply to their principal in their tenant

rules.statement: A principal attaches only policies of its own tenant document or of the platform layer that are attachable (C5); any other attachment is missing.
guards: engine:FlatEngineTest#only attachable policies attach, and the root policy never does

rules.statement: The platform document accepts no role bindings, and an app document accepts only role bindings.
guards: engine:CompiledDocumentTest#each kind of document binds only the subjects the candidate order reads from it

rules.statement: An anonymous principal matches no Principal binding and has no roles or attachments: only Anyone bindings apply to it.
guards: engine:FlatEngineTest#an anonymous principal has no attachments, principal or break-glass bindings

rules.statement: A role binding applies through the roles the principal has in the request's space, and only where its app and space match the scope exactly (case-sensitive, no trimming; * is Any).
properties: engine:FlatEnginePropertyTest#P10 the binding index agrees with a scan of every binding

rules.statement: A role binding that names a tenant applies only to principals of that tenant.

When an attached or bound policy id names both a policy of the principal's tenant document and a platform policy with different content, the request is Indeterminate(AmbiguousPolicy), unless a DENY matches; neither policy silently wins. The same content resolves (RFC 0007 N2).
A binding whose shape the candidate order can never reach (a subject or scope no request of that document can match) does not compile, so no DENY is lost silently.
A blocked principal is always denied, by the builtin blacklist rule, and the decision needs the platform document only.
guards: engine:FlatEngineTest#a blocked request is denied by the blacklist whatever else is unresolved

rules.statement: A break-glass principal is bound by every DENY (C2).
guards: engine:FlatEngineTest#root is a break-glass binding that permits everything but every deny

rules.statement: Break-glass bindings exist only in the platform document, bind only a principal, and must have expiresAt.
guards: engine:CompiledDocumentTest#break-glass bindings are expiring principal bindings of the platform

rules.statement: The break-glass root binding applies only to principals of the platform tenant; a root binding of any other tenant does not compile.
Break-glass is created only through the control plane: two people, a bounded lifetime, and a REQUIRED audit written first.
guards: control:BreakGlassControlTest#two people create it, each step recorded first
control:BreakGlassControlTest#without a REQUIRED listener, or when it fails, nothing is created
control:BreakGlassControlTest#its lifetime is bounded, when requested and when published

rules.statement: A change's kind is set by its entry point: a proposal is PUBLISH or BREAK_GLASS, never ROLLBACK, EXPIRE, MIGRATE or BOOTSTRAP, and a change that creates or alters a break-glass binding needs cosec:breakglass and a REQUIRED audit whatever its kind.
guards: control:ControlReviewFixesTest#a change's kind is never its input's
control:ControlReviewFixesTest#creating or altering break-glass needs cosec breakglass and a REQUIRED audit, whatever the kind

rules.statement: Any applicable DENY that matches makes the decision Deny, whatever errors, missing or unavailable inputs exist elsewhere (C1b).
properties: engine:FlatEnginePropertyTest#P1' adding a matching deny always denies
engine:FlatEnginePropertyTest#the decision is that of the pseudocode

rules.statement: Without a matching DENY, a DENY that fails (the statement or its policy's condition) makes the decision Indeterminate(MatcherFailed).
properties: engine:FlatEnginePropertyTest#the decision is that of the pseudocode

rules.statement: Without a matching DENY, an unresolved input (a missing attachment or policy, a required document unavailable or not loaded) makes the decision Indeterminate, never Permit.
properties: engine:FlatEnginePropertyTest#P9 missing and unavailable data never permit

rules.statement: An ALLOW that fails counts as no match (C1a).
properties: engine:FlatEnginePropertyTest#the decision is that of the pseudocode

rules.statement: When nothing matches the decision is the implicit deny Deny(null).
properties: engine:FlatEnginePropertyTest#the decision is that of the pseudocode

rules.statement: The candidate order decides only which statement is reported (by), never the kind of decision.
properties: engine:FlatEnginePropertyTest#P8 the decision does not depend on the candidate order

rules.statement: A policy's condition is evaluated at most once per evaluation, and only once one of its statements matched its action and resource (or failed matching the resource); untraced, nothing is evaluated after the statement that decided.
guards: engine:FlatEngineTest#a condition runs once per evaluation, also when policies share it
engine:FlatEngineTest#a condition is not evaluated when no statement of the policy matches the action and resource
properties: engine:IndexPropertyTest#ALG-7 a policy condition runs at most once, and only for a statement that matched its action and resource
engine:IndexPropertyTest#ALG-7 untraced, nothing is evaluated after the statement that decided

rules.statement: The decision does not depend on the trace level: what FULL and EXHAUSTIVE evaluate after the decision never changes it.
properties: engine:FlatEnginePropertyTest#P2 the decision does not depend on the trace level

rules.statement: Another tenant's document never changes a decision for this tenant's principals (P12).
properties: engine:FlatEnginePropertyTest#P12 another tenant's document never changes a decision

rules.statement: A tenant document references only its own tenant's or the platform layer's policies; anything else does not compile.
A tenant's principals write only their own tenant's documents (a hard rule, not a policy).
guards: control:ControlAuthorizationTest#the hard rule stands whatever the policies say

rules.statement: A tenant document may bind an app's permission policy only scoped to that app; the binding resolves the policy from that app's document in the same view, and anywhere else the document does not compile.
guards: cosec-core:PolicyDocumentCompilerTest#permission policies live in their app's document

rules.statement: Dangling and cross-tenant references do not compile; a request that reaches a Broken entry on the data plane fails closed (F4, F5).
The codecs neither encode nor decode Match.Exactly("*"): * only ever means Match.Any.
guards: cosec-core:PolicyDocumentCodecTest#the wildcard is only ever Any

rules.statement: A document whose schema is not this version's format fails to decode, as does one that is not exactly this format (an unknown field, a second operator, a value of the wrong JSON type), and the requests that need it fail closed.
Every document one evaluation reads comes from a single revision (P7).
properties: cosec-core:SnapshotConsistencyPropertyTest#everyEvaluationReadsOneRevisionPerDocument
rules.pending: a scenario format for snapshot timing (RFC 0008 §3.3); guarded by the test above
guards: runtime:DocumentSnapshotViewsTest#a view decides with the revisions it was built from

rules.statement: For one key, installs happen in the order loads started (P6).
properties: cosec-core:SnapshotInstallOrderPropertyTest#installsFollowLoadOrderAndConvergeInEveryFamily
cosec-core:SnapshotInstallOrderPropertyTest#installsFollowLoadOrderAndConverge
rules.pending: a scenario format for snapshot timing (RFC 0008 §3.3); guarded by the properties above

rules.statement: Snapshot caches have ttl = null and throw on failed reads; an instance refuses to start when Redis's maxmemory-policy is not noeviction.
guards: cosec-spring-boot-starter:CoSecPipelineAutoConfigurationTest#Redis that may evict snapshots fails startup unless told to warn

rules.statement: An absent attribute equals no value, not another absent one and not the empty string; exists is false for it.
guards: model:ConditionEvaluationTest#exists sees present values, empty ones included

rules.statement: A condition over a cost bound (nodes, depth, in values, CIDR blocks, literal length, total weight) does not compile.
properties: model:ConditionPropertyTest#A4 evaluation visits at most the node limit

rules.statement: Evaluation is two-valued: not negates its operand, so not over a comparison with an absent attribute is true.
properties: model:ConditionPropertyTest#A3 normalizing does not change decisions
guards: model:ConditionEvaluationTest#absent makes every comparison false and not negates it

rules.statement: Attributes are typed statically: a path outside the catalog, an operand of the wrong type, or a string literal for a Bool does not compile.
When a condition is true, the request's value of an indexable attribute is among the condition's index keys, or the keys are unconstrained (A1).
properties: model:AnalysisPropertyTest#A1 index keys admit every request the condition matches
model:AdversarialAnalysisTest#A1 holds on adversarial values

rules.statement: When implies(c1, c2) = YES, no request satisfies c1 but not c2 (A2).
properties: model:AnalysisPropertyTest#A2 implies is sound
model:AdversarialAnalysisTest#A2 holds on adversarial values

rules.statement: A value substituted for a path template variable never changes the pattern.
An unmapped route falls into the http namespace; an ALLOW on service:verb does not cover unmapped routes.
guards: runtime:PipelineRoutesTest#an unmapped request stays in the http namespace
cosec-core:RouteMapTest#a request no route matches stays unmapped, never a wildcard

rules.statement: A route map in which two routes may match one request (same method, paths not provably disjoint) does not load: a request has one action and one resource.
guards: cosec-core:RouteMapTest#routes one request could match do not load, whatever their actions

rules.statement: A captured path value that holds a slash (a decoded %2F) never becomes a segment of a typed resource id: the request is refused with 400.
guards: cosec-core:RouteMapTest#a capture that decodes to a slash never becomes a segment of a resource id
runtime:PipelineRoutesTest#a capture holding a slash is refused, never read as another resource

rules.statement: A malformed route map, or one with any malformed route, does not load: a route map loads whole or not at all.
guards: cosec-core:RouteMapTest#a malformed route does not load
cosec-core:RouteMapTest#one bad file fails every file, a route map never loads in part

rules.statement: The candidates the index yields are a superset of the statements a brute-force match finds (I1, I2).
properties: engine:IndexPropertyTest#I1 the index never leaves out a statement that can match
engine:IndexPropertyTest#I1 the decision is that of a scan without the index, DENYs first
engine:IndexPropertyTest#I2 index parameters never change the decision

rules.statement: Status codes come only from StatusMapping, and the three adapters answer the same request identically.
Indeterminate is always 503; 500 is kept for unmodelled exceptions.
properties: runtime:ProblemBodyPropertyTest#problemBodiesHoldOnlyTheAllowedMembers

rules.statement: External cancellation never produces an Outcome, and the downstream is never called.
No failure or timeout of any SPI produces a Permit (P13).

A path with a dot segment after one decoding, in any encoding (including after removing path parameters, with an encoded ';' and with '\' as a separator), or longer than 2048 characters, or with a segment longer than 256 characters, is answered 400 before authentication.

A credential that is invalid, expired or revoked is evaluated as anonymous: a permit proceeds, and a deny answers 401 with the token-* problem type that names why (token-invalid, token-expired, token-revoked), never unauthorized.

Only the revocation store's own degraded read may count a token as not revoked (the documented exception to failing closed); an error the revocation check reports fails the request with 503, never accepts the token.

A request that carries an API key is judged by the key alone, never by a token it also carries: an unknown, disabled or expired key is a rejected credential (evaluated as anonymous, a deny answers 401 token-invalid), and a key store that cannot be read answers 503.
An external attribute that cannot be fetched never turns a Deny or Indeterminate into a Permit (P9'), except a platform DENY with onMissing nomatch, which lapses by design (ATR-3).
properties: engine:ExternalAttributesPropertyTest#unavailableAttributesNeverPermitAndThePlanIsComplete

rules.statement: Obligations run only with a Permit; denied requests consume no rate-limit quota (P15).
No failure of a BEST_EFFORT listener changes the Outcome; a REQUIRED failure can only turn a Permit into 503.
A candidate containing any Broken entry is not published, and the head does not move.
The revision record is written before the head, and the head carries its parent.
simulate, explain and analyze call the same Engine.evaluate as enforcement, and explanations are built by the enforcing flow.
guards: control:ControlPlaneTest#simulate decides with the enforcing flow and shows only what the caller may read
control:ControlPlaneTest#explain decides at the revisions an audit event recorded

rules.statement: A head is replaced only over the digest of the base it was published on; a stale base conflicts, nothing is overwritten and the change is not rebased automatically.
guards: cosec-cocache:RevisionChainTest#two instances publishing on the same base never overwrite each other

rules.statement: A platform or app candidate that removes a policy another document's binding refers to is not published; the back-reference index is added to before a head moves and removed from only after.
A document has at most one staged change; another stages only once it is published, abandoned or expired.
guards: cosec-cocache:RevisionChainTest#changes stage one at a time across instances and publish once

rules.statement: Every check of a change is bound to its base: a change whose base moved never publishes, and a rebase runs every check again on the new head.
guards: control:ControlFailClosedTest#a moved base conflicts and publishes nothing, a rebase checks again

rules.statement: Every control-plane write is checked target by target with the control plane's own policies, through the same engine, before anything is recorded: cosec:write on each entry, cosec:grant on each scope a binding grants in, and the step's own action on the document. Anything but a permit refuses it: 403, or 503 when it cannot be decided.
guards: control:ControlAuthorizationTest#nobody writes without the right, and nothing is recorded
control:ControlAuthorizationTest#an undecidable check, a failed confirmation and a failing analysis all refuse

rules.statement: Publishing checks the publisher again on the current heads: their authorization of every target and the grant analysis. What they cannot publish alone waits for approval, and nothing is written.
guards: control:ControlAuthorizationTest#publishing checks the publisher again on the current heads

rules.statement: A staged change's shadow window closes only when the instances' samples that compared (not BASE_MISMATCH) reach the minimum after the minimum duration, or at the maximum duration as insufficient; a change still shadowing never publishes.
guards: control:ShadowWindowTest#two instances sample a window that closes from their reports, and the publisher acknowledges it
control:ShadowWindowTest#a window without enough samples closes at its longest as insufficient

rules.statement: A window that saw WIDENED, NARROWED or BECAME_INDETERMINATE requests, or closed with insufficient samples, publishes only when the publisher acknowledges exactly its window and counts.
guards: control:ShadowWindowTest#two instances sample a window that closes from their reports, and the publisher acknowledges it

rules.statement: A candidate that an instance cannot compile or evaluate (CANDIDATE_ERROR) closes the window at once, and the change never publishes.
guards: control:ShadowWindowTest#a candidate an instance cannot compile closes the window at once and never publishes

rules.statement: Creating or revoking a break-glass binding has no shadow window; any other change skips its window only with cosec:skip-shadow and a recorded reason.
guards: control:ShadowWindowTest#break-glass has no window, and skipping one needs a reason that is recorded

rules.statement: The control plane refuses a tenant policy whose id the platform document already uses (422); the data plane would read such an id as ambiguous unless both contents are the same.
Every step that names a change answers a caller who may not read its document exactly as it answers for a change that does not exist (404), before the change's state is looked at.
guards: control:ControlReviewFixesTest#a change another tenant may not read is the same 404 at every step, before its state
control:ControlHttpTest#a body kind is refused, and another tenant's change answers like a missing one

rules.statement: Every granted fragment is contained in one of the grantor's own ALLOWs and overlaps no non-Anyone DENY the grantor is subject to.
properties: control:GrantPropertyTest#A5 the grant analysis is sound
control:GrantPropertyTest#A6 narrowing is sound
control:GrantPropertyTest#A8 changes analyzed as contained never grant beyond the grantors
engine:PatternContainmentPropertyTest#A7 action containment is sound
engine:PatternContainmentPropertyTest#A7 typed resource containment is sound
engine:PatternContainmentPropertyTest#A7 http path containment is sound

rules.statement: A fragment the analysis cannot decide goes to platform administrator approval; it is never let through as probably contained.
properties: control:GrantPropertyTest#A5 the grant analysis is sound
guards: control:ControlAuthorizationTest#what the analysis cannot prove waits for another person's approval of its digest

rules.statement: A change with escalations publishes only after a person other than its author, holding cosec:approve on the document, approves the candidate digest they saw.
guards: control:ControlAuthorizationTest#what the analysis cannot prove waits for another person's approval of its digest

rules.statement: An approval is valid for cosec.control.approval.expire-after (72 hours); an expired one publishes nothing and the change awaits approval again.
guards: control:ControlAuthorizationTest#an expired approval publishes nothing and asks again

rules.statement: A holder of cosec:approve on the document is the trust root: its own changes are not analyzed and need no second person, unless four-eyes is on, when what the analysis cannot prove needs another holder.
guards: control:ControlAuthorizationTest#the trust root publishes alone unless four-eyes is on

rules.statement: A new or changed break-glass binding always needs a second person's approval, whoever proposes it.
guards: control:BreakGlassControlTest#two people create it, each step recorded first

rules.statement: A platform boundary can only turn a Permit into Deny or Indeterminate (P-B2); without boundaries it is the identity (P-B1).
properties: engine:FlatEnginePropertyTest#P-B1 a boundary that allows everything is the identity
engine:FlatEnginePropertyTest#P-B2 a boundary never permits what is not permitted without it
engine:FlatEnginePropertyTest#P-B3 a boundary decision does not depend on the candidate order
guards: cosec-core:PolicyDocumentCompilerTest#boundaries live in the platform, only allow, and are never bound

rules.statement: An ALLOW skipped because an external attribute it reads cannot be fetched makes what would be the implicit deny Indeterminate (503); another matching ALLOW still permits, and onMissing nomatch makes it a plain miss.
A DENY may say onMissing nomatch only in the platform document, where it lapses while its attribute cannot be fetched; elsewhere the document does not compile.
A policy that reads an external attribute no registered AttributeProvider declares does not compile.
A provider that fails or times out makes only its own attributes unavailable; the other providers' attributes are still read, so their DENY still matches.
A DENY with onMissing nomatch compiles, in any document, only with the confirmation the control plane records (onMissingConfirmed); it then lapses while its attribute cannot be fetched.
A blacklist that cannot be read is never "not blocked": the request is Indeterminate (503) unless a DENY matches.
A permit through a break-glass binding proceeds only when a REQUIRED listener recorded it; without one registered it is 503.
A permit whose rate limit rule is exhausted is 429 too-many-requests, with Retry-After and the RateLimit headers; the later rules spend nothing.
A rate limit rule that cannot be counted refuses the request with 503 unavailable when it is strictFailure, and is skipped otherwise (the documented exception to fail closed).
